name: axiomra-website
description: Run this file's scripts from the ROOT axiomra folder. It installs and runs the client and server for you — you do NOT need to cd into client/ or server/ yourself.

scripts.setup: npm run install:client && npm run install:server
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix server test
